root_cause.queue_state: No READY task remained after support/thesis tasks were terminalized.
root_cause.g1_integration_gate: Dependencies were marked TERMINAL, but its registry adapter class FOCUSED_REVIEW was not dispatched by execute_task and the task became ADAPTER_NOT_CONFIGURED.
root_cause.terminalization_defect: run_codex_task returned TERMINAL when an expected artifact existed, parsed output existed, and the process exited zero; it did not independently validate the artifact against the G1 contract or catalog success requirements.
root_cause.checkpoint_defect: The controller never commits the lab worktree. It atomically updated only control queue/state/scorecard, leaving artifacts and invocation evidence untracked in the local-only lab.

recovery_requirements: Preserve every existing artifact and invocation bundle.
Recompute contract-specific synthetic validations before accepting an existing G1 artifact.
Require a registered FOCUSED_REVIEW dispatch path for g1-integration-gate.
Add a regression test where recovered G1 prerequisites release g1-integration-gate rather than reaching NO_OP.
Commit validated lab evidence locally and only then atomically reconcile the control checkpoint.

blocking_findings: G1-INT-001 decision-interval protocol conflicts with frozen allowed candidates and evidence
G1-INT-002 known-answer fixtures do not instantiate required point-in-time lineage
G1-INT-003 execution kernel does not enforce frozen next-bar-open execution semantics
G1-INT-004 walk-forward fixtures omit mandatory purge and embargo

interrupted_invocations.preservation: Original invocation directories and finalization records retained locally.
interrupted_invocations.controller_repair: Orphaned RUNNING tasks now require a dead or PID-reused child before safe retry.
